end.summary:
Identified that curved surfaces roll and flat faces slide.
Explained that flat faces can support stacking.
Recognised that the same object can roll, slide, or stack in different positions.
Answered most prediction questions without help; teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Anika practised sorting and predicting whether objects roll, slide, or stack. They explained their answers using curved surfaces and flat faces, and corrected a mix-up about the ghee tin: it can roll when on its curved side and stack when placed on a flat face. At home, try rolling a bottle and sliding a book, then ask Anika which part touches the surface.
